content: Hello, thanks for reaching out to support! How can I assist you today?
Hi, I’m helping my daughter reset her account password. She forgot it and can’t log in.
No problem. Could you please navigate to the login page and click the 'Forgot Password?' link below the password field?
Okay, I see the link. I’ve clicked on it.
Great! Now you should see a prompt asking for the email address associated with her account. Please enter her email and submit the form.
Done, I entered her email address and clicked submit.
Perfect. You should now receive a password reset email. Once it arrives, open the message and click on the reset link provided.
We got the email and clicked the reset link. It’s asking to set a new password.
Go ahead and enter a new password for her account, then confirm it by typing it again in the second field. After that, press the 'Save' button.
All set! The new password is saved and she can log in again. Thank you for your help.
